newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures end up, but off highs.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures end up, but off highs.

text.p: June 5 - Most U.S. stock index futures closed higher, but off session peaks. Sell-stop orders were hit in June S&Ps at 845.80 to 846.20. Two U.S. dealers were consistent sellers throughout the day. Rebound in tech stocks supported most contracts, but tone was cautious ahead of U.S. labor data. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
